result.instructions: Tools for StoreRocket, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List all my StoreRocket locations in Texas."; "Hide the Downtown Seattle location from the store locator."; "Change the phone number and Monday opening hours of my Portland store.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes StoreRocket data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run storerocket_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run storerocket_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run storerocket_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. storerocket_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: storerocket_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: The StoreRocket user the API token belongs to: id, name, email and company. GET /user.

tools.name: storerocket_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the StoreRocket projects (store locators) the token's user belongs to: public id, name, number of locations, status and plan. Use the id as project_id in every location tool. Location tools need a project on the Business plan (API access). GET /projects.

tools.name: storerocket_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the locations of a project (name, address, city, coordinates, phone, visibility, location type, marker, cover image), 25 per page by default, with optional filters on name, address, city, state, country and postal code and optional hours/filters/custom fields/calls to action. Needs the location:read permission. GET /projects/{project_id}/locations.

project_id.description: Public project id (from storerocket_list_projects), kept as a string.

name_operator.description: How name is matched: eq (exact, default), ne (not equal) or like (substring).

include_hours.description: Include opening hours on every location (default false).

include_filters.description: Include search filters on every location (default false).

include_fields.description: Include custom fields on every location (default false).

include_calls_to_action.description: Include calls to action (buttons) on every location (default false).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: storerocket_get_location
tools.title: Get location
tools.description: One location by id, optionally with its opening hours, search filters, custom fields and calls to action. Needs the location:read permission. GET /projects/{project_id}/locations/{location_id}.

project_id.description: Public project id (from storerocket_list_projects), kept as a string.

location_id.description: Public location id (from storerocket_list_locations), kept as a string.

include_hours.description: Include opening hours on every location (default false).

include_filters.description: Include search filters on every location (default false).

include_fields.description: Include custom fields on every location (default false).

include_calls_to_action.description: Include calls to action (buttons) on every location (default false).

tools.name: storerocket_create_location
tools.title: Create location
tools.description: WRITE: add a location to a project's store locator. name and city are required; supply lat and lng for a precise pin (otherwise StoreRocket geocodes the address, which can be off). It appears on the live locator immediately unless visible is false, so set visible=false for a coming-soon or draft location. Opening hours: omit, or give all seven days. Creating twice makes two locations, so check storerocket_list_locations before retrying after an error. Needs the location:create permission. POST /projects/{project_id}/locations.

project_id.description: Public project id (from storerocket_list_projects), kept as a string.

lat.description: Latitude, -90 to 90. Supply with lng for an exact pin.

lng.description: Longitude, -180 to 180. Supply with lat for an exact pin.

visible.description: Whether the location shows on the locator. Set false to keep it hidden.

location_type.description: Name of an existing location type in the project.

hours.description: A FULL week: all seven days (mon..sun), each a range like 09:00-17:00 or closed. Omit for no schedule.

tools.name: storerocket_update_location
tools.title: Update location
tools.description: WRITE: change selected fields of one location with a partial update (PATCH): only the fields you send change, everything else is kept. The change shows on the live locator at once. Use null to clear phone, email, url, socials or cover; hours accepts single days (hours:{mon:'09:00-17:00'}), null for a day clears it, hours:null removes the whole schedule; fields and calls_to_action merge by name (a null value removes that entry); filters REPLACES the list ([] clears it). To take a location off the locator without deleting it, set visible=false. An invalid value saves nothing. Needs the location:update permission. PATCH /projects/{project_id}/locations/{location_id}.

project_id.description: Public project id (from storerocket_list_projects), kept as a string.

location_id.description: Public location id (from storerocket_list_locations), kept as a string.

address_line_1.description: Street address. Send null to clear it.

lat.description: Latitude, -90 to 90. When moving a location, send the new lat and lng together (an address change alone keeps the old pin).

visible.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the location on the locator.

phone.description: Phone number. Send null to clear it.

email.description: Email address. Send null to clear it.

url.description: Website URL. Send null to clear it.

location_type.description: Name of a location type in the project; null restores the project default.

marker_id.description: Id of a marker in the project; null restores the project default.

cover.description: Cover image URL or the project's stored image name; null clears it.

hours.description: Days to change (mon..sun or full names), each 'HH:MM-HH:MM', 'closed' or null to clear; null removes the schedule; {} keeps it.
